turnout_basis: votes cast (incl. informal and disallowed) as % of enrolled electors

government.name: Fifth National Government (second term)
government.notes: National (59 seats) renewed confidence-and-supply agreements with ACT (1), United Future (1) and the Māori Party (3): 64 of 121 seats. New ministry appointed at Government House 14 Dec 2011. The election was held alongside a referendum on retaining MMP (MMP retained, 57.8%).

notes: Electorate majorities/runners-up are taken from the official-count vote tables in each electorate's Wikipedia article (which cite the Electoral Commission's official results pages); where the summary table, the article's majority box and the candidate vote counts disagree, the value two of them agree on is used – see 'majority_corrections'.

Cross-check: national party-vote totals vs the sum of per-electorate official party votes in the electorate articles – largest gap +98 votes (nz-first, 0.00% of valid votes); gaps are attributed to transcription errors in individual electorate articles, and the national (Electoral Commission summary) figures are used.
sources: https://archive.electionresults.govt.nz/electionresults_2011/e9/html/statistics.html (official Electoral Commission results; blocked by Cloudflare from this environment, values taken via Wikipedia which cites it)
